requirement_text.REQ-428: Third MOB-4 requirement. Task routes (lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex): GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/claim, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete. The task form is resolved through REQ-424's pinned resolver and rendered by REQ-427's form renderer; never the active version. Process-instance renderer: read-only view of GET /api/v1/instances/:id and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex) -- status, current step, timeline. No cancel/rebind/advance actions (not in MOB-4). All screens use REQ-426's six-state wrapper; claim/complete errors (409 already claimed, 403, 422) map to its states.

task.description: Run WF-02 Step 2c's scope test (docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md): git diff main...HEAD (against this branch, feature/WF02-REQ428-20261001) and decide whether it touches a tenant-data path per security-invariants.md's applicability notes. This diff adds apps/mobile/lib/renderers/task/task.dart and apps/mobile/lib/renderers/process/process.dart plus tests -- read-only task/instance listing, claim/complete against existing authenticated endpoints via the existing ApiClient (no new auth/token/transport code; it reuses REQ-422's token store and REQ-425's single API client unchanged). Determine PASS (out of scope) or, if you find it does touch auth/token storage/transport (MOB-2/MOB-5/MOB-6 territory) via some mechanism not obvious from this description, run the full INV-1..INV-8 checklist instead.
acceptance_criteria: Scope test result stated explicitly with reasoning, not just a verdict
If in scope: INV-1..INV-8 each marked APPLIES/NOT-APPLICABLE with a verification note for each APPLIES invariant
If out of scope: PASS with next_action routing to REVIEWER (2d)
